prompt: When should the woman give the instruction?
promptZh: 女子應何時給出這項指示？

options.text: As the group first approaches the stand.
options.whyZh: 女子提出這時點，男子要她等提示。

options.text: While the group is still looking at the controls.
options.zh: 團體還在看控制裝置時。
options.whyZh: 要等團體看完控制裝置。

options.text: When the stand is turned around again.
options.whyZh: 轉向影響定位說法，不是開口時機。

options.text: When the man says the sample can be put in.
options.whyZh: 男子指定固定口令後才說明。

explanationZh: 男子指定固定口令後才說明。
evidence: Should I say that as the group comes up to the stand? / Wait until I say “ready for the sample.” We use that same cue after each group has had a look at the controls.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Should I say that as the group comes up to the stand?

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Wait until I say “ready for the sample.” We use that same cue after each group has had a look at the controls.

vocabulary.note: 這裡指一句讓對方知道何時可以做下一步的口頭提示。
